{{Top|leg}}
'''Claf group''' consisted of three [[Delta-class JV-7 escort shuttle|''Delta''-class JV-7 escort shuttles]], in the service of the [[Mugaari pirates]]. They were involved in the [[Recapture of Outpost D-34|Second Battle of Javin]] where [[Outpost D-34]] was recaptured by [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] forces from the ''[[Fogger]]''. They attempted to attack the ''Fogger'' but all three escort shuttles were destroyed.
